items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Did you know Martinez? No, I don't believe I did. It seems as though there was a Martinez in the union, an old timer.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was around there somewhere.

In fact, I think it might have been one of Tom, might have been Tom Anderson's. Because in those days, he worked around those places singing, you know, working with these old piano players. You know, he knew quite a good bit of them. Some called the name of Martinez, the old piano player. And he worked with Buzzy Williams. You know, he worked with quite a number of them. Did you know Martinez? No, I don't believe I did. It seems as though there was a Martinez in the union, an old timer.
And I just don't recall his first name right now. But I know that he played down there.
